players.product: copper-clad laminates with in-house electronic fibreglass yarn / fabric (incl. low-Dk, low-CTE and quartz specialty yarn) and RTF / HVLP copper foil for high-frequency, high-speed AI boards

quarterly_data.quarter: Kingboard Laminates HKEX announcement: Positive Profit Alert (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Positive profit alert (30 July 2026, preliminary and unaudited): based on management accounts, the board expects net profit of more than HK$2.8 billion for the six months ended 30 June 2026, an increase of more than 200% year on year, primarily from the tight market for laminates and their upstream materials (electronic fibreglass yarn, electronic fibreglass fabric, copper foil): unit prices of the Group's laminates and upstream materials rose significantly and laminate sales quantity also increased. The board says the market faces an increasingly severe supply shortage of yarn, fabric, copper foil and laminates, and credits the Group's vertical integration.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2026 net profit expected to exceed HK$2.8 billion (more than +200%)
